name: WdOMathVertAlignType
description: Specifies the vertical alignment of equations within the shape canvas or the line, for inline equations.

constants.name: wdOMathVertAlignCenter
constants.description: Vertically centers the equation in the shape canvas or line.

constants.name: wdOMathVertAlignTop
constants.description: Aligns the equation on the top of the shape canvas or line.

constants.name: wdOMathVertAlignBottom
constants.description: Aligns the equation on the bottom of the shape canvas or line.
